Conformément aux directives formulées pa: In accordance with the guidelines issued by the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications to support the victims of the recent forest fires, the public operator is setting up an exceptional free-of-charge scheme encompassing local and national fixed telephone communications, as well as Internet connection. This offer aims to enable affected citizens to stay in touch with their loved ones during this ordeal, while facilitating the coordination of field actions carried out by the various stakeholders involved in rescue operations.
Ce programme de gratuité bénéficie à la: This free-of-charge program benefits both the localities directly hit by the flames and the neighboring municipalities that have offered refuge to evacuated residents. The measure is planned for a duration of one week and aims to ensure the continuity of communication means in the concerned territories.
L'entreprise exprime par ailleurs sa rec: The company also expresses its gratitude to all mobilized actors, including Civil Protection, civil and military authorities, constituted bodies, as well as volunteers and citizens who came from all wilayas to lend a hand. As a corporate citizen, the operator reaffirms its willingness to mobilize all its human and technological resources in the service of the population, while maintaining a permanent listening channel via its contact number.
